name: binding-states-exact-in-facet-rejected
description: A facet binding declaring state 'exact' is refused: 'exact' is a slot-binding-only state, since a facet axis has no hierarchical-code denotation for it to narrow.
notes: 'exact' is unrecognised for a facet binding and falls through the same catch-all as any other unrecognised state, matching the failure category a bogus facet-binding state already gets.
